desc:
⚔️ Fight endless monsters, defeat bosses, and summon powerful heroes!

🌟 Collect rare heroes with unique stats, Traits, and Mutations
🪙 Earn Coins and upgrade your Skill Tree
👑 Defeat bosses to earn Hero Souls
🔥 Rebirth for permanent Totem upgrades
🌍 Unlock new zones and climb endless stages
🏆 Compete in weekly leaderboards

Build the strongest hero team and become the ultimate Soul Hero!

👍 Like and favorite for updates!
